name: Amantadine
mechanism: Enhances dopaminergic neurotransmission (uncertain exact mechanism) and has NMDA-antagonist properties
dosing: Typical 100 mg twice daily; adjust for renal impairment
contraindications: Severe renal impairment unless dose adjusted; hypersensitivity
interactions: Anticholinergics, other CNS-active agents; caution with QT-prolonging drugs
monitoring: Renal function, confusion or hallucinations, peripheral edema
sideEffects: Confusion, hallucinations, peripheral oedema, livedo reticularis, dizziness, insomnia
pharmacokinetics: Oral, renally excreted (dose adjust in renal impairment)
clinicalPearls: May help reduce dyskinesia and improve motor symptoms in Parkinson's disease; useful in acute levodopa-induced dyskinesia in some cases.
indication: Symptomatic management of Parkinson's disease; reduction of levodopa-induced dyskinesia in selected cases
